review_goal: Use the intended pricing source during checkout while preserving correct charge amounts and source-of-truth behavior.

directions.prompt: Trace value, state, identity, ordering, and precision changes through their real business effects.
Check trust boundaries, authorization, validation, and secret handling around the changed behavior.
Check whether changed interfaces, schemas, configuration, migrations, and rollout order remain compatible.

findings.title: Keep checkout on the authoritative pricing source
findings.body: For `annual-plan`, this passes the analytics value of 100 cents to the irreversible charger instead of the authoritative 10,000 cents, undercharging every such order by 99%. The added source metadata explicitly marks analytics as reporting-only and potentially 24 hours stale, so checkout must continue using `AuthoritativePrice`.
